title: Explore all locations before acting
description: When target object not immediately visible, systematically visit each location.
content: Instead of repeatedly looking at the same spot, move to each listed location to discover objects. The success trajectory found the statue by going to shelf 2 after shelf 1.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a statue in sidetable.

title: Use "move" command when "put" fails
description: When an object placement action returns "Nothing happens"
content: If "put X on Y" yields no result, try "move X to Y" instead. The move command often succeeds where put fails.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two alarmclock in desk.

title: Use correct action verb for object manipulation
description: When an initial action fails, try synonymous commands
content: If "pick up" or "put" fails, try "take" or "move" with explicit source/destination. Success used "take mug 1 from countertop 2" and "move mug 1 to coffeemachine 1" after "pick up" and "put" failed.

source.task_query: Your task is to: clean some mug and put it in coffeemachine.

title: Use correct action verb for object interaction
description: When an object is in a container, use the specific action verb (e.g., "cool with") rather than generic "put in"
content: In the success trajectory, the agent used "cool mug 1 with fridge 1" to cool the mug, while the failure trajectory attempted "put mug 1 in fridge 1" which did nothing. Always check admissible commands for the correct action verb.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some mug and put it in coffeemachine.

title: Open containers before searching for target objects
description: When looking for an item in a closed container, open it first.
content: Always open closed containers (cabinets, drawers, fridge) before checking contents; otherwise you may miss the target object.

source.task_query: Your task is to: heat some plate and put it in sidetable.

title: Use "take" not "pickup" for objects
description: When an object is visible but "pickup" fails
content: If "pickup <object>" returns "Nothing happens", try "take <object> from <container>" or "take <object>" to successfully acquire it.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a pencil in sidetable.

title: Use "move" instead of "put" for placement
description: When an object is in inventory and "put" fails
content: If "put X on Y" returns "Nothing happens", try "move X to Y" instead. The move command often succeeds where put fails.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two watch in shelf.

title: Use "move" command to place held item
description: When "put" fails to transfer an item to a container
content: After picking up an item, if "put [item] in [container]" returns "Nothing happens", use "move [item] to [container]" instead.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two cd and put them in drawer.

title: Use correct verb for object placement
description: When an action fails repeatedly, try a different verb with the same meaning.
content: If "put" or "place" fails to move an object into a container, try "move" or "drop" instead. The environment may only accept specific verbs.
